import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path('D:/wt/r18-sdk-client-fix1')
allow_path = pathlib.Path('D:/wt/r18-evidence-index-diagnosis/reports/runs/recovery_r18_evidence_git_index_diagnosis_20261016/exact_raw_allowlist.json')
allow_bytes = allow_path.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(allow_bytes).hexdigest() == '654594478601998b303d92afc3b3c53955d1c993235ba2683ece248f1c30ef17'
allow = json.loads(allow_bytes)
run_path = root / allow['scope']
manifest_bytes = (run_path / 'artifact_manifest.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest_bytes).hexdigest() == allow['expected_manifest_sha256']
manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes)
paths = [entry['path'] for entry in allow['files']]
assert len(paths) == len(set(paths)) == allow['count'] == 57

def git(*args, input_bytes=None):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), *args], input=input_bytes,
                          capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30).stdout

assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == allow['expected_head']
git('diff', '--cached', '--quiet')
git('diff', '--exit-code', '6d85742b0114cc5e304e88b2aa930755ccce9bc9', '--', 'sdk/python')
assert (run_path / '.gitattributes').read_bytes() == b'*.log binary\n*.xml binary\n*.raw binary\n'
attrs = git('check-attr', '--stdin', '-z', 'text', 'diff', 'merge',
            input_bytes=b'\0'.join(path.encode() for path in paths) + b'\0').split(b'\0')
assert all(value == b'unset' for value in attrs[2::3])
before = {entry['path']: (root / entry['path']).read_bytes() for entry in manifest['files']}
assert len(before) == 110
for entry in manifest['files']:
    raw = before[entry['path']]
    assert len(raw) == entry['size_bytes']
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == entry['sha256']

git('add', '--renormalize', '--', *paths)
for path, raw in before.items():
    assert (root / path).read_bytes() == raw
    expected = raw if pathlib.Path(path).suffix in {'.log', '.xml', '.raw'} else raw.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
    assert git('show', ':' + path) == expected, path

git('diff', '--exit-code', '6d85742b0114cc5e304e88b2aa930755ccce9bc9', '--', 'sdk/python')
git('diff', '--cached', '--check')
print('Exact 57-path restage and all 110 blob proofs passed; no commit performed.')
